notes: JSON payload shapes are the official InvestRight docs samples (fetchltp, overall_position, holdings, funds_and_margins, order_status, trade_book, place_order, modify_order, cancel_order) with prices, ids and names replaced by dummy values; two invalid-JSON typos in the docs samples (a missing quote after OPTIDX in order_status, a trailing comma in overall_position) are fixed. The docs do not describe the security-master columns, so the CSV header is copied from the live file (October 2026) and the rows are dummies in that format. OI/volume/depth come from the WebSocket and are stubbed in hdfcsecurities.test.mjs.
